Adventure Read completion popup: original PE decompilation

Images are the two files configured by data/runtime/native-pe-images.json.
Steam identity: PE:6a70a6d9:02711000.
Official Windows identity: PE:6a70b91c:0270a000.
reference-decompiled.c and classic-decompiled.c are actual Ghidra 12.1.4 C
output from the original disk images, x86:LE:64:default:windows, -noanalysis,
using tools/DecompileAdventureReading.java. They retain 17 complete core
functions per edition. reference-suppliers-decompiled.c and
classic-suppliers-decompiled.c retain actual current-PE Ghidra C for all
21 typed general_ref description suppliers (including the inherited empty
description) and the complete sphere selector, in a separate suppliers pass.
Together the two passes retain every function in native-functions.tsv as
actual current-PE C. Descriptive names are aliases, not debug symbols.
The extraction does not attach to or observe a game process.

native-functions.tsv retains every full chained-unwind owner and the code
boundary before embedded selector data. The matching *.asm files retain all
decoded instruction operands. native-branches.tsv includes branch targets
and fallthrough; native-predicates.tsv preserves source cmp/test/bt operands;
native-switches.tsv includes every native selector and table alias;
native-calls.tsv includes direct and virtual suppliers; native-literals.tsv
includes original RIP-relative text loads and inline string fragments;
native-emits.tsv retains all 12 direct announcement submissions per edition.

SOURCE CHAIN

Item caption                       0xc65450..0xc65f0a      0xc62490..0xc62f4a
Unit Read item                     0xb3df0..0xb5f4c        0xb3d80..0xb5edc
Interaction power update           0x1352f20..0x1353937    0x134de90..0x134e8a7
Adventure modal renderer           0x8020c0..0x802a5e      0x7ff940..0x8002de
Announcement row builder           0x8a40e0..0x8a44a7      0x8a1960..0x8a1d27
Read page carrier                  0xcc7020..0xcc75f8      0xcc4060..0xcc4638
Read writing carrier               0xcc6a10..0xcc7020      0xcc3a50..0xcc4060
Written work body                  0xcc5d50..0xcc6a0e      0xcc2d90..0xcc3a4e
Written work style                 0xcc5520..0xcc5d50      0xcc2560..0xcc2d90
Announcement submit                0xe3c20                0xe3bb0

READ ACTION: three mutually exclusive text alternatives
The action's selected item pointer is action+0x10. It clears report timers
and sets adventure announcement flags before selecting its outcome.
The exact native visibility predicate is retained rather than inferred:
    visibility_supplier(unit) != 0 && unit.word[0x814] != 0 &&
    (refresh_visibility(), (unit.u32[0x114] & 0x6000000) == 0)
If true: submit "You cannot see." with packed event/color 0x400ea.
Otherwise look up skill 0x5b at unit.soul(+0xa98)+0x218.
Missing skill or rating(+4) <= 0:
    submit "You cannot read." with packed event/color 0x400ea.
Present skill with rating > 0:
    caption = item_caption(action.item, out, flags=0, context=1)
    submit "You read " + COMPLETE caption + ".", packed 0x700ea.
    then call Unit Read item(unit, action.item).
Every action announcement respects its type-234 announcement settings:
gamemode == 0 uses settings & 0x70; other modes use settings & 8.
Disabled settings omit text but successful reading still calls Unit Read item.

COMPLETE TITLE/CAPTION
The native caption is not always written_content.title.
It can select an artifact's native generated name, a BOOK's nonempty title
at item+0xe8, a TOOL's first nonempty referenced work title (including scroll
tools), or the complete native item designation with qualities/material/binding
modifiers. The item_type enum in data/upstream/df-structures/df.d_basics.xml
identifies TOOL as 0x56, SLAB as 0x57, BOOK as 0x59, and SHEET as 0x5a.
The complete item-caption function is retained for both PE images. Its
selected title and designation remain one dynamic field of the Read sentence.
An artifact name can have has_name=true but no contributing first name,
nickname or generated name words. The caption's c654b9..c654e2 branch tail-
calls a94030 and returns without a nonempty-output fallback. The Read action
still appends its final period, yielding the complete production "You read .".
has_name=false instead falls through to the ordinary item caption and must
not be confused with that empty contributed-name branch.

UNIT READ ITEM: eight direct emit sites
All normal content emissions require gamemode == 1, unit == current adventurer,
and the type-234 setting's adventure display bit (8). Two special slab paths
use the native option supplier for type 234 instead of directly reading bit 8.

SLAB (item virtual type 0x57):
  subtype(+0x10c) == 6 and linked ID(+0x108) != -1:
    when writing(+0xe8, length at +0xf8) is nonempty and allowed:
      submit '"' + the complete raw writing string + '"', packed 0x300ea.
    collect linked interaction ID even when no text is submitted.
  subtype == 26 and linked ID != -1:
    same quoted-writing emission, packed 0x300ea.
    resolve linked historical figure/event knowledge through their real IDs.
  every other slab subtype, including missing special linked ID:
    nonempty writing -> same quoted-writing emission, packed 0x300ea.
    empty writing -> "It has no writing.", packed 0x700ea.
The quoted string is copied from item+0xe8; it is not an adjacent RAW title
guess. Its possible writing genres include the existing linked memorial,
secret/true-name and shop-sign suppliers described by their own source data.

BOOK (virtual type 0x59; TOOL is 0x56, SLAB is 0x57):
  Iterate every improvement in item+0xd0..+0xd8 in source order.
  Improvement virtual getType(+0x28) == 9 means pages.
  Present pages with a nonempty work-ID vector(+0x30..+0x38):
    page_carrier(improvement, complete output, native mode R9D=0)
    submit that WHOLE output, packed 0x700ea.
    collect all referenced work IDs.
  Present pages with an empty work-ID vector:
    submit "The pages are blank.", packed 0x700ea.
  No page improvement found:
    submit "It has no pages.", packed 0x700ea.
Multiple page improvements can each submit a separate whole paragraph.

WRITING ON ANY APPLICABLE ITEM:
  If item virtual method +0x5a8 returns true, iterate its improvements.
  Improvement getType(+0x28) == 12 and ID vector(+0x28..+0x30) nonempty:
    writing_carrier(improvement, whole output, native mode R8D=0)
    submit that WHOLE output, packed 0x700ea; collect all work IDs.
  Empty writing improvements and unsupported improvement types emit nothing.
This pass follows the slab/BOOK pass; it is not a mutually exclusive subtype.

POWERS: one looped direct emit site
Reading collects explicit SLAB linked interactions and general_ref_interaction
(reference type 0x2f, ID at reference+8) from work subjects. Learning applies
interaction effects and invokes unit-interaction-power-update.
For each effect, iterate its parallel granted interaction ID/target vectors.
Skip unless target equals effect+0xd8; append the ID to unit+0x8f8..+0x900.
Only a newly appended ID can display a learning announcement.
The original conditions then require:
  gamemode == 1; nonempty adventure unit vector; unit == current adventurer;
  interaction virtual type == 0x16 (CE_CAN_DO_INTERACTION);
  its name string(+0x378) length(+0x388) != 0;
  type-258 announcement display setting permits it.
The native string construction is exactly:
    'You have learned the power "' + interaction.string(+0x378) + '"!'
with packed event/color 0x30102. Arbitrarily many new powers can be submitted;
missing names, other interaction kinds and already known IDs emit nothing.
The dynamic power name belongs to the interaction RAW/generated effect field.

WRITTEN WORK GENRE / KNOWLEDGE BRANCHES
The Unit Read item function has a 20-entry remap and a 20-entry genre switch
for selectors 5..24. They are retained including repeated destinations.
Biographies, genealogies, cultural histories/comparisons, encyclopedias and
star works update the native knowledge flags; poems/music/choreography add
their form IDs. Default genres omit these category-specific updates. Subject
roles 0/5 can apply value/reference knowledge and interaction IDs. These
branches do not directly emit additional text in this popup. Their complete
state-update control flow remains in the actual C and original instructions.

FULL PROSE SUPPLIERS
Both PE decompilations retain page and writing carriers, the complete work
body and its style function, native cardinal/ordinal chapter suppliers, and
poetic/musical/dance form suppliers. The source-derived genre table has all
26 genres and its default; subject joins, untitled and missing-work branches,
authors, all 18 styles/strengths/polarity, all five quality categories and all
six quality levels, chapter lists and default/empty references are preserved by
these complete functions and the native selectors in this directory.
The quality-category switch is 0/default prose, 1 compilation, 2 poetry,
3 composition, 4 choreography. The current PE's five thresholds are
10, 20, 30, 40 and 50, yielding six levels in each category.
Every typed general_ref supplier is retained as complete current-PE ASM and
actual current-PE C in reference-suppliers-decompiled.c or
classic-suppliers-decompiled.c. native-functions.tsv identifies each supplier's
edition, original address range, instructions and actual decompiled source.
../written-reading/elf-decompiled.c additionally preserves the corresponding
Linux binary source; it does not substitute for the current-PE supplier C.
Their semantic productions and field provenance are already documented in
../written-reading/decompiled-productions.txt and
../character-knowledge-written-work/decompiled-source.txt.

WRAP AND RENDER OWNERSHIP
The native row builder wraps report.text at 95 columns when its length > 95.
Every resulting adv_announcementst row retains report as row.parent(+0x20).
For shorter text the row string is empty and drawing uses report.text(+8).
The renderer selects row.str, falling back to parent.text only when empty.
Non-continuation report.flags(+0x30)&1 == 0 and speaker(+0x64) == -1 are
centered; other records preserve their native speech/continuation placement.
These are physical wrap rows of whole reports, not independent source text
sentences. Caption, body and learned powers retain distinct report ownership.

These files preserve source text/control flow. They are not game observations,
translation results, test fixtures, checks or acceptance reports.
